story.titleZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛：维斯塔潘升至第四，伊萨克跻身前三
story.summaryZh: 红牛车队在X上发帖，第4圈时伊萨克在第一赛段超越勒克莱尔进入前三，维斯塔潘正紧追勒克莱尔争夺第四位。
story.originalTitle: Smoooooth like butter... Max is up to P4 🧈
story.summaryEn:
Smoooooth like butter... Max is up to P4 🧈Oracle Red Bull Racing: LAP 4/51: ALLEEZZZ ISACK 👏
The Frenchman is inside the top three, having bopped his way past Charles in the first sector.
Max is now hassling the Monegasque over P4...
#F1 || #AzerbaijanGP 🇦🇿
detailZh: 红牛车队在X上发帖：“Smoooooth like butter... Max is up to P4 🧈。第4圈/共51圈：ALLEEZZZ ISACK 👏 这位法国车手在第一赛段超越勒克莱尔后跻身前三。维斯塔潘现在正紧追这位摩纳哥车手争夺第四位…… #F1 || #阿塞拜疆大奖赛 🇦🇿”
